svg.text: Phase 1
Phase 2
Phase 3
Phase 4
WASM runtime (wasm.rs)
Wire wasmtime instantiation — currently all stubs
ABI boundary: MessagePack over linear memory — serialize PluginEvent/PluginToolDescriptor through
ptr+len pairs. Fix the Box::leak 'static hack — use an interned string slab.
MCP bridge expansion (mcp_bridge.rs)
Current tools cover lifecycle only — add authoring + deployment loop
Also add: plugin_rollback (swap back to previous artifact), plugin_logs (drain PluginEvent log
buffer), egui_widget_tree (serialize widget snapshot for AI observation).
PluginEvent dispatch (mod.rs process_events)
Currently only logs — wire into actual app systems
Broadcast loop
PluginManager needs a callback registration pattern so the app can hook RunScript/SendWsCommand
without the plugin module importing the full WS client. Suggest: EventDispatcher trait injected at
PluginManager::new(dispatcher). Keeps plugin/ dependency-free from app internals.
Also: wire host.broadcast() for ClientConnected / SystemInfoUpdated from app update loop.
Currently broadcast_tx exists but nothing calls it.
Remote viewer (remote.rs)
Struct + channels exist, frame serialization is the gap
Viewer-side replay
EguiRemoteViewer::ui() needs to: deserialize shapes_data via bincode, re-upload any texture
deltas with ctx.tex_manager().write(), tessellate with Tessellator, paint via ui.painter(). Note
ClippedShape is not yet stable-serializable in egui — may need a mirror type for the wire format.
Input forwarding (EguiInputEvent → RawInput) is already wired in input_hook — just needs WS recv.
EguiFrameCapture should be disabled by default (it is) — enable only when a viewer connects.
